project.name: [SANDBOX] Dogfood Medium - Profile Export Flow
project.brief: Add a profile export flow with backend endpoint, frontend trigger, tests, and release verification. Preserve existing auth and data semantics.
principles: Split backend, frontend, and verification into independently reviewable work.
Make parallel lanes explicit only when write scopes do not overlap.

issues.title: Guide: Agent Operating Guide
issues.description:
## Objective
Define dependency order, auth boundaries, safe parallelism, and ledger recovery for the profile export flow.

## Context
Backend and frontend can proceed in parallel after the endpoint contract is stable.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Original brief and non-scope are preserved.
- Parallel-safe lanes name owned write scopes.
- Continuous Discovery routes blockers and auth defects into new issues.

## Verification
Read back graph, dependencies, and ledger before implementation.

## Notes For Future Agents
Start with DOG-M-003 and DOG-M-004 only after DOG-M-002 defines the contract.

issues.title: Define profile export contract and auth expectations
issues.description:
## Objective
Specify the export endpoint contract and auth checks before implementation.

## Context
The backend and frontend lanes depend on this contract.

## Scope
- Owned work: API contract note and acceptance criteria.
- Non-scope: implementing endpoint or UI.

## Dependencies / Blockers
- Blocks: DOG-M-003, DOG-M-004.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Endpoint request and response are named.
- Auth and user-data ownership expectations are explicit.
- Verification expectations are attached to downstream issues.

## Verification
Review against local auth conventions and record any docs lookup requirement.

## Notes For Future Agents
If auth semantics are unclear, create a Decision required issue before implementation.

issues.title: Implement backend profile export endpoint
issues.description:
## Objective
Implement the backend export endpoint using the accepted contract.

## Context
This lane is parallel-safe with the frontend trigger once DOG-M-002 is complete.

## Scope
- Owned work: API route, server-side tests.
- Non-scope: frontend trigger and release docs.

## Dependencies / Blockers
- Blocked by: DOG-M-002.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Endpoint returns only the authenticated user's profile export.
- Unauthorized requests are rejected.

## Verification
Run backend route tests and record output in the ledger.

## Notes For Future Agents
Create a Defect issue if existing auth middleware behaves differently than expected.

issues.title: Implement frontend export trigger
issues.description:
## Objective
Add the profile export trigger in the account settings UI.

## Context
This lane consumes the accepted API contract and should not change backend semantics.

## Scope
- Owned work: account settings UI and component tests.
- Non-scope: API route internals.

## Dependencies / Blockers
- Blocked by: DOG-M-002.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Authenticated users can request an export.
- Loading and error states are visible.

## Verification
Run frontend component tests and a browser smoke check if available.

## Notes For Future Agents
If the UI needs new copy approval, propose a Documentation gap issue.

issues.title: Final verification and release handoff
issues.description:
## Objective
Verify the complete profile export flow and leave a handoff.

## Context
This is the serial gate after backend and frontend implementation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Backend and frontend tests pass.
- Auth behavior is checked end-to-end.
- Completion comment includes changed files, checks, risks, and follow-ups.

## Verification
Run the full profile export test command set and read back the ledger.

## Notes For Future Agents
Do not close until dependency links and completion evidence are present.
